concepts.intent: Cancel a pending dialog action.
preserve: The pending action is abandoned.
Do not use this concept for cancelling payments or subscriptions.

concepts.intent: Empty an editable input field.
preserve: The current field contents are removed.
The action does not delete a saved record.

concepts.intent: Clear the file selected in a file input.
preserve: The file field is cleared.
Describe record deletion only if the product actually deletes a stored file.

concepts.intent: Open the picker to select a file.
preserve: Selecting a file can happen before uploading it.

concepts.intent: Apply changes to the active form or editor.
preserve: Match the app's behavior for whether the change is saved permanently.

concepts.intent: Delete an item using the application's deletion behavior.
preserve: Use permanent-deletion wording only when irreversibility is established.

concepts.intent: Remove selected content and copy it to the clipboard.
preserve: Both the removal and clipboard behavior matter.

concepts.intent: Insert content from the clipboard.
preserve: The action inserts clipboard content.

concepts.intent: Select every item in the applicable scope.
preserve: Preserve the scope of what gets selected.

concepts.intent: Find text within the current document or text editor.
preserve: The search operates within the current content.

concepts.intent: Tell the user that an operation failed, without a specific reason.
concepts.ui: Error title, toast or inline error
preserve: Says that something failed, not merely that something happened.
Does not blame the user.
Pairs with status.retry when the operation can be repeated.

concepts.intent: Withdraw a token, key, session or app's granted access so it stops working.
preserve: The grant stops working; nothing in progress is aborted. Not dialog.cancel_action.
Name what is revoked (token, key, access) when the control allows.

concepts.intent: Name one permission granted to an API token or OAuth app, such as reading leads.
concepts.ui: Permission list label, count label or column heading
preserve: A permission or access range, not an optical scope (lens) or a project scope.
Keep the count before the noun where the locale counts that way.

concepts.intent: Name the CRM records for potential customers or organizations.
preserve: Use a noun for the record type.
Keep leads distinct from existing customer contacts and qualified opportunities.

concepts.intent: Find a language in the language picker.
preserve: The user is searching languages rather than searching all app content.

concepts.intent: Open the current page in an editor.
preserve: The current page becomes editable. Saving is a separate action.

concepts.intent: Open the underlying source representation of the current content for editing.
preserve: This action opens the source editor. It does not mean editing a data provider or source file unless that is the actual object.

concepts.intent: Close a dialog or sheet.
preserve: Dismissal does not imply a change to account or subscription state.

concepts.intent: Return to the previous screen.
preserve: The user moves backward in navigation.

concepts.intent: Advance to the next step of the current flow.
preserve: The step advances without implying submission or payment.

concepts.intent: Proceed without completing an optional step.
preserve: The user can omit this step.

concepts.intent: Complete the current flow.
preserve: The current task is complete after the action succeeds.

concepts.intent: Persist changes to the current record or settings.
preserve: Changes are stored.
Savings and downloads are separate concepts.

concepts.intent: Store incomplete work to resume later.
preserve: The item is saved as a draft and remains unpublished.

concepts.intent: Abandon edits that were not saved.
preserve: Unsaved edits are lost.
The existing saved item is kept.

concepts.intent: Send form data for processing.
preserve: The form is sent.
Approval or success may still be pending.

concepts.intent: Tell the user a field must be completed.
preserve: Completing the indicated field is mandatory.

concepts.intent: Tell the user the entered value has the wrong format.
preserve: The issue is with input formatting.
Retain the example format when given.

concepts.intent: Add an item to the current collection.
preserve: The item becomes part of the current collection.

concepts.intent: Open an item for changes.
preserve: Opening edit mode is distinct from saving changes.

concepts.intent: Remove an association from the current list.
preserve: The item can still exist elsewhere.

concepts.intent: Permanently delete the underlying item.
preserve: The item will be deleted.
The operation is irreversible when the source says so.

concepts.intent: Move an item out of active use while retaining it.
preserve: The item is retained.
Restoration is possible only when the app supports it.

concepts.intent: Return a retained item to active use.
preserve: The existing item is recovered.

concepts.intent: Reverse the most recent eligible operation.
preserve: The command reverses a specific prior action.

concepts.intent: Copy a value for pasting elsewhere.
preserve: Copying creates a clipboard copy without removing the source.

concepts.intent: Retrieve a file onto the current device.
preserve: Data moves from the app to the user's device.

concepts.intent: Send a local file into the application.
preserve: Data moves from the user's device into the app.

concepts.intent: Expose this content to recipients or other apps.
preserve: The actual permissions and audience depend on the flow.

concepts.intent: Make a draft available to its configured audience.
preserve: Publishing changes visibility.
Specify public visibility only when the source says so.

concepts.intent: Find items that match a search query.
preserve: The user searches for a match.

concepts.intent: Report that nothing matched the current query or filters.
preserve: No match does not imply there is no data in the app.

concepts.intent: Remove the filters currently applied.
preserve: Clearing filters does not delete content.

concepts.intent: Start a session for an existing account.
preserve: The user signs into an existing account.

concepts.intent: End the current session.
preserve: The current session ends.
The account itself is retained.

concepts.intent: Create a new user account.
preserve: A new account is created.

concepts.intent: Update the password through an authenticated account flow.
preserve: This is a password update through settings.

concepts.intent: Start or complete password recovery according to the current step.
preserve: Match the current recovery step.
Do not imply a reset has completed if only a link is sent.

concepts.intent: Verify control of the email address.
preserve: Verification is about the address, not personal identity.

concepts.intent: Send another verification code.
preserve: A code is sent again.
Whether the previous code remains valid depends on the app.

concepts.intent: Report that the verification code is no longer valid.
preserve: Expiry is different from an incorrect code.

concepts.intent: Report that the current session is no longer valid.
preserve: The session ended.
The account remains available.

concepts.intent: Open the payment step without placing a charge yet.
preserve: The user moves to payment.
The current action has not charged them.

concepts.intent: Authorize or submit the payment at the current step.
preserve: The action submits payment.
Keep the stated amount and currency.

concepts.intent: Tell the user the payment has not reached a final outcome.
preserve: The outcome is pending.
Do not imply success, failure, or permission to retry.

concepts.intent: Tell the user the payment provider declined the payment.
preserve: The payment was declined.
Give a reason only when the app supplies one.

concepts.intent: Try the payment operation again.
preserve: This action starts another attempt.
Do not imply the previous charge failed unless confirmed.

concepts.intent: Cancel the current payment attempt or payment flow.
preserve: The action concerns the current payment.
It does not stop later renewals.

concepts.intent: Stop automatic renewal for a subscription.
preserve: Future automatic renewal stops.
Use the app's own rules for access and end dates.
Do not imply immediate termination.

concepts.intent: End the subscription immediately.
preserve: The change takes effect now.
Do not promise a refund.

concepts.intent: Report that a refund request has been submitted.
preserve: The request is recorded.
The payment has not necessarily been refunded.

concepts.intent: Report that the refund has been completed.
preserve: Use the actual completion state.
Keep amount, currency, and payment destination when provided.

concepts.intent: Describe the amount or percentage saved on a purchase.
preserve: Savings refer to money or a discount.
Keep the amount, percentage, and conditions.

concepts.intent: Tell the user that content is being retrieved or prepared.
preserve: The result is still in progress.

concepts.intent: Repeat a failed or interrupted operation.
preserve: The action repeats the current operation.
It does not indicate success.

concepts.intent: Grant the stated permission.
preserve: Name the resource and scope when the source provides them.

concepts.intent: Decline the requested permission.
preserve: This action declines access for the specified scope.
